Group rides in Jersey City, NJ

5 recurring group rides around Jersey City, NJ: 4 road, 1 social. 2 roll on weeknights, 1 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Bike JC Light-Up Ride in Jersey City — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Marty's Tuesday Evening Road Ride runs 17–18 mph in spring, 18–20 mph in summer.
